note: Message agent (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-27-voice-first-doddy.md, step 4). Same server path as the ask agent (voice-agent/task-call/): our server places the Twilio call and connects it with register-call, passing the variables compiled from the approved message card (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/payload.ts). Created by server/messaging/scripts/setup-task-call-agent.mjs --agent tell; the server's drift check compares the live agent with TASK_TELL_AGENT_SPEC in server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSpec.ts, which voice_agent_spec.py keeps in step with this folder.

variables.doddy_opening_line: AI disclosure + that Doddy brings a short message, and asks whether they have a moment (server-built)
variables.doddy_question: the one sentence that asks whether Doddy may pass on the message (server-built)
variables.doddy_principal: the user's first name in the genitive
variables.doddy_goal: not in the prompt: a fixed server-built sentence, never the person's goal, kept only for the shared variable set
variables.doddy_facts: only the facts the user ticked, one per line
variables.doddy_attempt: attempt id for matching the post-call webhook; not used in the prompt
variables.doddy_message_line: the one sentence that passes on exactly the approved message (server-built)

placeholders.doddy_opening_line: Dzień dobry, tu Doddy, wirtualny asystent Anny. Dzwonię z krótką wiadomością od Anny, czy mogę zająć chwilkę?
